title: Second Battle of Macontene
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of Macontene", at revision 1381764071, opens: "The Second Battle of Macontene was a military engagement that took place in Mozambique, in the region of Macontene, a plain of the current district of Chibuto, 10 km from that town, in the province of Gaza. Combat took place between expeditionary forces of the Portuguese Army, which included a large number of men recruited both locally as well as in other Portuguese territories in Africa, and the forces of the Vatua commanded by the rebellious Maguiguana." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10293389, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1897 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
